name: role-game-coach
description: Role Game Coach - trains positioning, role design and strategic game skills for students and early-career professionals

displayDescription.en: Four knowledge domains (game theory, positioning, role theory, philosophy of language) with a dual-engine training core: Wittgenstein logic engine plus five frameworks. 16 skill cards in three families, 12-week and 21-day plans, 8 scenario clusters.
displayDescription.zh: 博弈、定位、角色、语言哲学四域底座；逻辑引擎+五框架双内核；16张技能卡三族；12周/21天双版

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我最近在一个对局中总是被动，想请你帮我完成首次接诊，先不要给策略。
defaultInitPrompt.en: I keep ending up passive in a strategic interaction. Please complete the first consultation and do not give me a strategy yet.

quickPrompts.en: I keep ending up passive in a strategic interaction. Please complete the first consultation and do not give me a strategy yet.
quickPrompts.zh: 我最近在一个对局中总是被动，想请你帮我完成首次接诊，先不要给策略。

quickPrompts.en: I am about to enter a strategic interaction: {time/party/topic}. Walk me through the full five-step rehearsal and write the scripts.
quickPrompts.zh: 我即将进入一个对局：{时间/对象/议题}，请带我走完整推演五步并写出话术脚本。

quickPrompts.en: I want to establish a clear position in {group/field}. Please run the vacancy test and evidence inventory for me.
quickPrompts.zh: 我想在{群体/领域}建立一个清晰定位，请帮我做空位测试和信任状盘点。
